claims.text: The framework decomposes complex structural design tasks into subtasks handled by coordinated LLM agents with specialized expertise.
The multi-agent LLM framework achieves 97% accuracy compared against commercial engineering software SAP2000 in case studies on 30 beams.
The multi-agent LLM framework achieves a 90% time-saving in structural analysis and design.
A Graphical User Interface supporting natural language queries was developed to facilitate practical human-robot interaction.

evidence.description: Tested using case studies on the design and evaluation of 30 beams and compared against commercial engineering software SAP2000, demonstrating high accuracy (97 %).
Case studies demonstrated 90 % time-saving in structural analysis and design.

methodologies.name: Multi-agent LLM framework for code-compliant structural design
methodologies.description: Decomposes complex design tasks into specialized subtasks executed by coordinated LLM agents alongside a natural language GUI.
conditions: Comparison against SAP2000 commercial engineering software

limitations.text: The current manual approach for designing reinforced concrete, guided by structural design codes, is inefficient and susceptible to human error.
